desc: Tired of scope mounting being a time-consuming and tedious process that makes it hard to tell if you've truly aligned your reticle to the bore of your rifle? Conventional scope mounting can be a lengthy task involving several different steps. Luckily, the Reti-Level from Wheeler makes that a thing of the past. The Reti-Level replaces traditional bubble levels with an accurate, easy-to-read digital level, providing next-level precision. The built-in crosshair green laser bore sighter allows for unmatched accuracy by enabling you to level the rifle's bore to the reticle of your scope instead of relying on leveling off the turret cap, which can lead to unsatisfactory results. By combining scope leveling and bore sighting into a single, simple step, you save time and get on target with fewer shots. All components are neatly organized and secured in a high-quality latching hard case that stacks with other Wheeler sets for convenient, space-saving storage.
